findings.description: Actual SDK omits ACC_READ_FULL_WIDTH; RTL repository header defines it and RTL supports it.

findings.equation: q=Sat32(new_partial << carrier); first contribution ACC=q, later ACC=Sat32(old_ACC+q). Zero carrier 0x80000000 produces q=0. Old_ACC is not shifted.

findings.description: Header MAX_BYTES is emitted as literal 64, independently of dma_maxbytes. Audited configs also set dma_maxbytes=64.

unverified: No elaboration, simulation, synthesis, hardware run, deployment or cache-coherence experiment was performed.
Use of supplied SDK in a particular compiled binary is user-reported; build configuration was inspected but no compile database or binary was verified.
Physical system DMA address width and exception recovery for malformed commands are not established as common constants.
